items.title: [2026-06-20] Bring your shop online free this monsoon (Image Prompt)
items.content:
QckServe Store — ₹0 listing poster (monsoon, UP).

SCENE: A small but proud neighbourhood shop in a Tier-2 Uttar Pradesh town just after first monsoon rain — wet street reflections, glistening shutter, a few raindrops still in the air.
SUBJECT / POSE: A confident mid-40s Indian shopkeeper (kirana / general store owner) standing in the doorway holding a smartphone toward the viewer, warm half-smile, sleeves rolled, relaxed and in control.
PHONE UI MOCKUP: On the phone screen, a clean QckServe 'Store' listing card — shop photo thumbnail, shop name, a big flat orange button reading 'List free · ₹0', and a small 'owner-direct' chip. Flat UI, no gradients, crisp.
COLOUR SYSTEM: dominant brand orange #FF6B00 and deep charcoal #1A1A1A, secondary accent #ef6723 / #a43d00, neutral wet-grey street, warm skin tones. Flat solid colour blocks only — NO gradients.
LIGHTING: soft overcast post-rain daylight, gentle rim light on the shopkeeper, subtle reflection glow off the wet ground.
TYPOGRAPHY HIERARCHY: oversized condensed bold headline space top-right ('YOUR SHOP, ONLINE'), an italic-serif accent word 'free' in orange, small Poppins supporting line, '₹0' as the visual hero numeral.
EYE FLOW: top-left logo zone → shopkeeper's face → phone screen → ₹0 hero → qckserve.in/store at bottom.
CAMERA: 35mm, eye-level, shallow depth of field, shop softly bokeh'd behind subject, 4:5 vertical crop.
PERFORMANCE LAYER: thumb-stopping warmth + a single bold price promise; reads instantly even as a small feed thumbnail.
LAYOUT: reserve the TOP-LEFT ~140px square logo zone empty — logo placed manually. Keep bottom-left clear for 'qckserve.in/store'.
